new_entities.name: SavingsAccount
new_entities.description: A personal savings account (easy access, fixed-term, notice, or ISA wrapper). Owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core). The primary entity for deposit-taking, interest accrual, and ISA wrapper management.

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: Primary key

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: FK → Customer (ENT-001)

fields.name: account_number
fields.description: 8-digit UK bank account number

fields.name: sort_code
fields.description: 6-digit sort code (no hyphens)

fields.name: account_type
fields.description: Type of savings product

fields.name: status
fields.description: Account lifecycle status

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Always GBP for personal savings accounts

fields.name: balance
fields.description: Current account balance in GBP

fields.name: interest_rate_aer
fields.description: Annual Equivalent Rate — the marketed rate

fields.name: interest_rate_gross
fields.description: Gross interest rate before tax (ISA: gross = net as tax-free)

fields.name: interest_frequency
fields.description: Interest payment frequency

fields.name: is_isa_wrapper
fields.description: True if this account is a Cash ISA wrapper

fields.name: isa_subscription_id
fields.description: FK → IsaSubscriptionRecord (ENT-066) — only if is_isa_wrapper = true

fields.name: fixed_term_end_date
fields.description: Maturity date for fixed-term accounts — null for easy access

fields.name: notice_period_days
fields.description: Notice period in days for notice accounts — null for easy access and fixed

fields.name: maturity_instruction
fields.description: Instruction for fixed-term account at maturity

fields.name: fscs_protected
fields.description: Always true — all retail deposits are FSCS-eligible up to £85,000

fields.name: source_of_funds
fields.description: Source of funds for AML purposes — required if initial deposit > £10,000

fields.name: opened_at
fields.description: Account opening timestamp

fields.name: closed_at
fields.description: Account closure timestamp

relationships.description: Many SavingsAccounts may exist for one Customer
A Cash ISA SavingsAccount has one IsaSubscriptionRecord

new_entities.name: IsaSubscriptionRecord
new_entities.description: Tracks ISA subscription usage within a tax year. One record per customer per tax year per ISA type. Owned by SVC-001. Updated on every deposit to a Cash ISA account. Used for HMRC annual ISA return.

fields.name: subscription_id
fields.description: Primary key

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: FK → Customer (ENT-001)

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: FK → SavingsAccount (ENT-065)

fields.name: isa_type
fields.description: ISA product type — currently only cash_isa supported

fields.name: tax_year
fields.description: Tax year in format YYYY/YYYY, e.g. 2026/2027

fields.name: tax_year_start
fields.description: 6 April of the tax year start

fields.name: annual_allowance
fields.description: HMRC annual ISA allowance — currently £20,000

fields.name: subscription_used
fields.description: Total subscriptions made in this tax year — must not exceed annual_allowance

fields.name: subscription_remaining
fields.description: Computed: annual_allowance - subscription_used

fields.name: void_flag
fields.description: True if HMRC has voided this ISA subscription (e.g. breach of ISA rules)

fields.name: national_insurance_number
fields.description: NI number for HMRC ISA return — must match HMRC record

fields.name: isa_declaration_confirmed
fields.description: Customer confirmed ISA declaration at application: 'I have not subscribed to another Cash ISA this tax year'

fields.name: declaration_timestamp
fields.description: Timestamp of ISA declaration confirmation

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Record creation timestamp

relationships.description: One IsaSubscriptionRecord per SavingsAccount per tax year
One customer may have IsaSubscriptionRecords in multiple tax years

design_decisions.decision: subscription_remaining is a computed field (annual_allowance - subscription_used) rather than a separately stored field.
design_decisions.rationale: Eliminates data inconsistency — if subscription_used is the source of truth, subscription_remaining should always be derived. This prevents race conditions between separate update operations.

referenced_existing_entities.usage: Customer identity used for KYC validation and ISA eligibility check
